title: What a year of dementia care costs, by country income

metadata.source: World Alzheimer Report 2010 (ADI / Wimo & Prince), 2010 USD, current exchange rates.
metadata.note: Societal cost per person with dementia (informal care + direct medical + direct social care). India was in the lower-middle-income band. The number is far lower in poorer countries largely because so much care is unpaid and there is little formal/residential care — not because the disease is less burdensome.
